d:
The race for gold is never easy. In this Gold Rush Season 3 compilation, crews face tough mining conditions, equipment breakdowns and risky decisions as they push to bring in more gold. With money on the line and time running out, every setback threatens to derail their plans.
Can the miners overcome the challenges and make their hard work pay off?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 10, 2, 15, 11, 9, 16 and 14, on Discovery Channel India.
